Education · programme

Outstanding High School Senior Award

An award recognising community service and leadership in graduating high-school seniors. The register retired it in August 2026 by Board resolution, though afrp.org still offered it when the Hub's plans were written.

Branch
Education · A ladder by age
Owning entity
Unconfirmed: the prototype says afrp.org attributes it to AFRP; Program Architecture says the site groups it under the Ramallah Foundation. Confirm.
Shape
Award
Built in the Hub
Retired

Who it's for

High-school seniors with a 3.5 GPA minimum, whose applicant and family were members in good standing.

The operating year

Applications due 31 May each year; awards announced at the Convention. Retired effective 31 August 2026.

The five rungs

Not stated in the record for this programme. The five rungs are hear, show up, take part, give or serve, and lead (D25).

Who runs it

The Scholarship Committee, on an award track (prototype). What it escalates is not stated.

Money

Small fixed prizes as published on afrp.org: two first prizes of $1,000 and second and third of $500, as gift cards. Whose books is unconfirmed.

Hand-offs

Was fed by Camp Ramallah and fed the Scholarship. Its retirement leaves a gap between Camp and the Scholarship on the Education ladder.

What it needs

From the Federation's strategy
  • Part of the youth pipeline from childhood to professional life (2019 plan)
From the platform
  • Kept on the register as retired, with recipients, criteria and history preserved
  • A successor row is held as proposed; what replaces it is undecided

Open questions

  • What replaces the Award, keeping a reason for families to stay members while their youngest finishes high school?
  • The Award's 'family in good standing': national dues, club dues, or both?
